target.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): route OTLP exports through env proxy
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`diagnostics-otel` traces, metrics, and OTLP log exports currently instantiate the OpenTelemetry Node HTTP exporters with only the resolved OTLP URL and optional headers. The upstream OTLP exporters use Node `http`/`https.request` and do not honor OpenClaw's undici global dispatcher or trusted env-proxy guarded fetch path.

In sandbox environments where outbound auth is injected by the egress proxy, this can send OTLP trace/metric exports outside the proxy path even though model traffic and curl-based checks work through `HTTPS_PROXY`.

## Summary

- Resolve an OpenClaw Node env-proxy agent for each resolved OTLP signal URL.
- Pass that agent as `httpAgentOptions` to trace, metric, and OTLP log exporters only when the env proxy applies.
- Preserve default OpenTelemetry exporter agents when no env proxy applies or the target is bypassed by proxy rules.
- Add regression coverage for proxied and non-proxied exporter construction.

## Evidence

- `fnm exec --using v22.21.0 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts --reporter=dot`

```text
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  97 passed (97)
```

- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.ts extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts`

```text
All matched files use the correct format.
```

- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.ts extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts`

```text
passed
```

- `git diff --check`

```text
passed
```

- `fnm exec --using v22.21.0 node scripts/check-plugin-sdk-subpath-exports.mjs`

```text
OK: all referenced openclaw/plugin-sdk/<subpath> imports are exported.
```

- `fnm exec --using v22.21.0 node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs --mode=plugin-sdk-internal`

```text
No extension plugin-sdk boundary violations found.
```

- `fnm exec --using v22.21.0 node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs --mode=src-outside-plugin-sdk`

```text
No extension plugin-sdk boundary violations found.
```

## Local Proxy Proof

Before supplying a Node proxy agent to `OTLPTraceExporter`, a fake local proxy saw no traffic and the exporter failed with direct DNS resolution:

```text
export error: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND example.invalid
fake proxy events: <none>
```

After supplying the OpenClaw env proxy agent via `httpAgentOptions`, the same exporter reached the fake proxy:

```text
agent created: true
export result code: 1
export error: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
fake proxy events: CONNECT example.invalid:443
```

## Notes

- `CHANGELOG.md` is release-owned per repo policy, so this PR does not edit it.
- A direct `tsc -p extensions/diagnostics-otel/tsconfig.json --noEmit` is not a useful local gate for this package today: it fails on existing plugin-sdk subpath resolution and unrelated strictness errors before isolating this change.
